question: In Indus valley civilization, the city of Lothal stood beside a tributary of the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sabarmati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lothal:-**

 
 
• It was an important city of the Indus Valley Civilization located in modern-day Gujarat, India.
 
 
 
• **Sabarmati:-**
 
 
• It is a river that flows through western India and joins the Arabian Sea.
 
• It is one of the largest rivers in Gujarat and is known for its historical and cultural significance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Periyar:-**

 
 
• It is a river in southern India that flows through Kerala.
 
• It is known for its importance in the agriculture and economy of the region.
 
 
 
• **Krishna:-**
 
 
• It is a major river in southern India that flows through the states of Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is known for its cultural and religious significance in Hinduism.
 
 
 
• **Narmada:-**
 
 
• It is a major river in central India that flows through the states of Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Gujarat.
 
• It is known for its scenic beauty and religious significance.
